headlines.title: 구로·동대문도 월세 400만원
headlines.summary: 강남3구·용산 뺀 21개 자치구 작년보다 고액월세 35% 증가 서울에서 월세 400만원이 넘는 고가 임대차 계약이 늘고 있다. 그동안 강남권에 집중된 고가 월세가 한강 벨트를 넘어 구로구와 동대문구 등 외곽에도 등장했다. 전·월세 물건이 줄어드는 가운데 ‘전세의 월세화’가 빨라지면서 월세 상승 압력이 커지고 있다는 분석이 나온다.

headlines.title: 500만원 넘는 초고가 월세 올들어 1620건 … 마포-성동 등 확산
headlines.summary: 1년새 18% 늘어 4년만에 2배로 강북 월세 상승률, 강남보다 높아 서울 누적상승률 5.73% 역대 최고 “수요 꾸준한데 세 부담에 매물 줄어” 최근 전월세 가격 상승세가 계속되며 월 500만 원 이상을 내는 초고가 월세 거래량도 늘어나고 있는 것으로 나타났다. 강남권에 이어 비(非)강남권까지 월세가 가파르게 오르며 초고가 거래 사례가 나오고 있다.

headlines.title: 7월까지 41조 더 걷혀 올해 국세수입 274조
headlines.summary: 관리재정수지 적자 64조로 줄어 5년來 최저 ‘월간 재정동향’ 9월호. 사진 제공=기획예산처 올해 7월까지 걷힌 국세가 전년 동기보다 41조 원 넘게 늘면서 나라살림 적자가 5년 만에 가장 작은 수준으로 줄었다. 다만 세수 호조에도 중앙정부 채무는 올해 들어 86조 원 넘게 증가하면서 향후 재정 건전성에 대한 부담은 여전한 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 9월 누적 수출액 급등 … 82% 증가한 350억弗
headlines.summary: 관세청은 이달 1~10일 수출액이 350억달러로 지난해 같은 기간보다 82.6% 증가했다고 11일 밝혔다. 이는 월별 초순 수출액 가운데 역대 가장 큰 규모다. 반도체 수출이 165억달러로 급증해 전체 수출 증가를 견인했다. 품목별로는 반도체 수출이 전년 동기 대비 270.1% 늘어난 165억달러로 집계돼 1~10일 기준 최고 기록을 새로 썼다.

headlines.summary: ■경인사연·KDI 토론회 수출 변동·미래 재정수요 반영 제시 기획처 “축적·상환 비율 함께 고민” 11일 서울 양재동에서 열린 ‘2027년 예산안 및 미래대응기금 토론회’에 참석한 김세직 한국개발연구원장이 인사말을 전하고 있다. KDI 제공 미래대응기금의 적립액과 국채 상환 규모를 정하는 별도의 준칙을 마련해야 한다는 제안이 11일 나왔다.

headlines.title: 與, “ 국민연금 , ‘주가누르기’ 방지 위해 스튜어드십코드 이행평가 강...

key_headlines.title: Deputy PM Koo Clarifies Real Estate Tax Reform as Incentive Shift, Not Punishment
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yun-chul stated that the government's real estate tax reform changes compensation from property ownership to actual residence, not a punitive measure. The reform allows exceptions for reasonable cases like studying abroad or work relocation.

key_headlines.title: Japan's Producer Prices Surge 7.6% in August for Third Consecutive Month Above 7%
key_headlines.summary: Japan's producer price index rose 7.6% in August, exceeding market expectations and marking three consecutive months above 7%, driven by surging raw material prices and AI-related demand. This creates upward pressure on consumer inflation and raises prospects for additional rate hikes.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's Tax Revenue Increases 41 Trillion Won Through July, Fiscal Deficit Hits 5-Year Low
key_headlines.summary: National tax revenue through July increased over 41 trillion won year-over-year, reducing the managed fiscal deficit to 64 trillion won, the lowest in five years. However, central government debt still increased 86 trillion won this year, raising concerns about future fiscal sustainability.

key_headlines.title: US-Japan Rate Decision Week Looms as Fed Rate Hike Probability Reaches 86%
key_headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve's September 15-16 FOMC meeting carries significant implications as market pricing shows 86.3% probability of a 0.25% rate hike. The outcome could trigger market turbulence regardless of the decision, amid concerns about inflation and geopolitical uncertainties.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Prices Maintain 83-Week Consecutive Rise, Approaching Record 85-Week Streak
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment prices have risen for 83 consecutive weeks and are on the verge of breaking the previous 85-week record from the Moon Jae-in administration. A 'triple rise' phenomenon in sales, jeonse, and monthly rental prices continues, with ultra-high monthly rents exceeding 3 million won now spreading beyond Gangnam.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic recovery momentum faces mixed signals as employment strengthened with 184,000 new jobs in August and unemployment held steady at 2%, but consumer price inflation surged to 3.1%, raising monetary policy concerns. The government highlights the solid recovery trend while acknowledging uncertainties from Middle East tensions and potential US tariffs. Deputy PM Koo clarified the real estate tax reform shifts incentives from property holding to actual residence rather than serving as punishment. Tax revenue through July increased 41 trillion won year-over-year, bringing the fiscal deficit to a five-year low of 64 trillion won, though central government debt continues to accumulate. The economy benefits from semiconductor boom-driven purchasing power, though policy uncertainty and supply constraints fuel panic buying in the housing market.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's fiscal position improved significantly with tax revenue through July reaching 274 trillion won, 41 trillion won above the previous year, reducing the managed fiscal deficit to 64 trillion won, the lowest in five years. However, central government debt rose 86 trillion won this year, indicating continued fiscal sustainability challenges despite improved tax collection. Employment markets showed resilience with August job creation of 184,000 exceeding July's 108,000, while unemployment remained stable at 2%, suggesting labor market recovery is gaining traction. Real GDP growth is forecast at 3.2-3.5% for 2026 by major domestic and international institutions, supported by semiconductor sector strength. Youth employment remains problematic despite overall economic recovery, raising concerns about labor market inclusivity and long-term demographic challenges.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI recovered to above 7,000 points, gaining 3.33% for the week as semiconductor stocks including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix led the rebound. However, concerns about US interest rate hikes and geopolitical tensions from Middle East conflicts continue to weigh on market sentiment, with the index facing volatility around the 7,000 level. US Treasury yields and oil prices spiked amid escalating US-Iran tensions, creating headwinds for Korean equities despite initial gains. The CME FedWatch tool shows 86.3% probability of a September Fed rate hike, positioning markets for significant moves ahead of the FOMC decision on September 15-16. Currency depreciation against the dollar threatens to undermine semiconductor company profit forecasts, offsetting gains from semiconductor production surge.
sections.Industry & Technology: Twenty-seven companies including AI and semiconductor firms plan to invest 1.530 trillion won in South Chungcheong Province, supporting the region's manufacturing ecosystem expansion. Battery pressure measurement technology is advancing with applications expanding across semiconductors, robotics, and energy storage systems, particularly for EV battery safety and stability. Retail investors are rebalancing semiconductor ETF portfolios toward more diversified holdings including gold, nuclear power, and secondary battery stocks, indicating profit-taking from semiconductor concentration. SK AX received the Minister of Employment and Labor Award for AI talent training and innovation in human resource development, demonstrating corporate contributions to workforce upskilling. Semiconductor sector concentration is gradually shifting toward diversification as investors recognize valuation risks and seek exposure to complementary technology sectors.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices have risen for 83 consecutive weeks and are approaching the previous record of 85 consecutive weeks from the Moon Jae-in administration, driven by semiconductor boom-related purchasing power and policy distrust leading to panic buying. A 'triple rise' phenomenon encompasses sales prices, jeonse, and monthly rental rates simultaneously, with ultra-high monthly rents exceeding 3 million won spreading beyond traditional Gangnam strongholds to broader Seoul areas. The Yeouido-Noryangjin-Heukseok area is emerging as a core residential region in southwestern Seoul, with particular attention to Singil-dong's redevelopment and reconstruction projects. Gwangju apartment prices have risen for nine consecutive weeks following semiconductor investment announcements, with model houses experiencing heavy visitor traffic as speculative demand rises. Supply-side constraints, liquidity abundance, and psychological factors continue to support real estate appreciation, with particular momentum in areas benefiting from semiconductor infrastructure proximity.
sections.International Economy: Trump pressures the Federal Reserve to maintain the world's lowest interest rates ahead of the September 15-16 FOMC meeting, warning of trade suspension with countries running deficits if the Fed raises rates. Market expectations show 86.3% probability of a Fed rate hike, creating uncertainty about the administration's threats and their potential implementation. Trump's pressure on the Fed continues despite the central bank's institutional independence, with concerns that a rate hike could trigger a market confidence crisis. The administration has reaffirmed opposition to Chinese companies producing in Mexico for US export, while supporting foreign investment in US-based production. France downgraded its 2026 growth forecast to 0.5% due to fiscal uncertainty and summer heat waves and wildfires, with national debt at 117.6% of GDP far exceeding the eurozone average of 88.9%.
sections.AI & Economy: SK Chairman Chey Tae-won emphasized that AI industry sustainability requires demonstrating actual profit generation and reinvestment capability to dispel bubble concerns, noting promising progress with major tech companies regarding the Ulsan AI data center project. Four major AI leaders including Dario Amodei advocate for slower AI development speeds amid concerns about unfettered investment and potential bubble risks, with some executives like Elon Musk and Demis Hassabis expressing agreement. Twenty-five Fields Medal laureates warned that AI companies' mathematical problem-solving competitions may harm mathematics research and academic integrity, cautioning against reductionist approaches to mathematical understanding. Oracle's aggressive AI data center investment announcement boosted Dell and Hewlett Packard Enterprise share prices approximately 12% as AI infrastructure buildout accelerates. The Small and Medium Business Administration plans to measure SME growth potential using AI and concentrate support on high-growth enterprises, integrating artificial intelligence into policy implementation.
sections.Others: Lotte and KAIST jointly inaugurated the Lotte-KAIST R&D Center in Daejeon, a six-story facility funded by 10 billion won from Lotte, focused on AI-based biotechnology, carbon-neutral energy, and healthcare technology development and commercialization. The controversy over 'AI speed control' advocated by major AI leaders has created investor concerns about semiconductor sector momentum, prompting strong warnings from President Trump about maintaining AI development pace. Small Business Administration Minister nominee Lee So-young proposed using AI to measure SME growth potential and prioritize support for high-growth enterprises as part of policy innovation. Oracle's substantial AI data center investment announcement immediately boosted AI infrastructure stocks, signaling strong momentum in AI-related hardware and equipment sectors. The debate between AI industry leaders advocating slowdown and policymakers favoring acceleration continues to create uncertainty about AI development trajectory and its economic implications.
